# Broadside Prototype — Version History

`../index.html` always mirrors the latest playable version. Each version is kept self-contained so it can be opened directly in any modern browser (Edge / Chrome).

| File | Date | Highlights |
|---|---|---|
| `broadside-v1.0.html` | 2026-10-18 | Initial 1v1 PvP / PvE prototype: 8 channels on Launch Control XL, 8×8 Launchpad blueprint damage control, dynamic lateral ocean ballistics, procedural Web Audio cannon synthesizer. |
| `broadside-v2.0.html` | 2026-10-20 | **Full 2-Player Asymmetric Co-op, Fleet Defense & Fader Safeguard**: <br>• **Configurable Fleet / Fader Argument**: Default is **1 Boat (4 Turrets · CH 1–4)** to protect against hardware fader issues (such as a faulty 7th fader on Launch Control XL). Can be scaled up to **2 Boats (6 Turrets · CH 1–6)** or **3 Boats (8 Turrets · CH 1–8)** via top menu or URL parameters (`?boats=1`, `?boats=2`, `?boats=3`). Inactive channels are completely bypassed and ignored, preventing phantom inputs.<br>• **Player 1 (Gunner - Launch Control XL)**: Controls fleet guns on active channels. Guns use limited ready-racks (3–4 shells) and depend on the engineer to hoist munitions from deep magazines.<br>• **Player 2 (Engineer - Launchpad MK2)**: Manages warship cross-sections via top-row buttons (`FLG` / `SWF` / `VAL`) with firefighting, breach welding, system repairs (pumps, boilers, steering, rangefinder), manual hoist cranking, and fleet helm speed & smoke orders.<br>• **Point Defense & Radar Mode**: Top-row `RDR` switches Launchpad to 8×8 tactical radar. Detects incoming **Rockets** (fast ballistic), **Cruise Missiles** (guided low-altitude), and **Torpedoes** (underwater wakes). Engineer taps sectors or uses side buttons to detonate **Flak Bursts** (air) and drop **Depth Charges** (water) to intercept incoming ordnance.<br>• Bi-directional hardware LED feedback for both Launch Control XL and Launchpad MK2 with hot-plug support, on-screen interactive mirrors and AI Engineer Assist toggle for solo testing. |
